title: SNT release manifest, v2
description: release_manifest.json, attached as an asset to each GitHub release of snt-stratification: every file the release delivers to a workspace, with its sha256, and by which route each one travels. Produced by tools/build_manifest.py, run by .github/workflows/release.yaml (both Phase 3 of docs/MIGRATION_PLAN.md). Consumed, from Phase 4, by snt_workspace_deployer, snt_pipeline_deployer and snt_workspace_checker; until then they read v1 (release_manifest.v1.schema.json). Prose: release_manifest.md. Repo path = workspace path (ADR 0038): a path in files or filesystem_files is the same in the repository and in the workspace filesystem. A consumer reads every schema_version from 2 on that it knows, and refuses an unknown one with an [ERROR] (ADR 0042). Compatibility rules, as for status_report.schema.json: adding a key is NOT a breaking change; renaming or removing a key, changing a type, or changing what a value means is breaking and bumps schema_version. This schema is deliberately strict (additionalProperties: false) so a producer cannot drift silently; a CONSUMER must instead ignore unknown keys. Invariants that hold but cannot be expressed in JSON Schema, so a validator must check them separately (invariant_errors() in tools/build_manifest.py): (1) every pipelines entry's path is 'pipelines/' + its key; (2) every zip_files list contains 'pipeline.py'; (3) for every pipeline P and every entry M of its zip_files, the path P.path + '/' + M is a key of files; (4) every filesystem_files entry is a key of files; (5) every key of files is in filesystem_files, in some zip_files, or both; (6) every webapps entry's path is 'webapps/' + its key + '/app'.

schema_version.description: The manifest shape. v1 manifests carry no such key.

version.description: The release tag this manifest describes (GITHUB_REF_NAME), e.g. v0.1.0. On a manual run it is the branch name instead. Consumers identify a release by its GitHub tag_name; this field is for a reader of the file on its own.

repo.description: The GitHub repository the release belongs to, as owner/name (GITHUB_REPOSITORY), e.g. BLSQ/snt-stratification.

files.description: Every file the release delivers to a workspace, by either route: {repository path: sha256}. Which route a file takes is said by filesystem_files and by pipelines.*.zip_files, never derived from the path. A file can take both routes: a notebook under pipelines/<name>/code/ is copied to the workspace filesystem and also ships inside its pipeline's zip.

filesystem_files.description: The keys of files that the deployer copies into the workspace filesystem, each at its own path: the R half of each pipeline (code/ and reporting/ notebooks, utils/ R files) and the shared R library under shared/r/. A key of files that is not listed here ships only inside a pipeline zip (pipeline.py, requirements.txt, readme.md, ...). Sorted by the producer; may be empty.

pipelines.description: {pipeline name: pipeline spec}, one entry per folder pipelines/<name>/, the name being the folder name and the @pipeline id. Covers every kind in pipelines/registry.json, bootstrap pipelines included (ADR 0042). May be empty, but must be present.

repository_files.description: Files a pipeline fetches from the repository at run time, at the release tag, rather than receiving them by deployment: {repository path: sha256}. Today the files matching catalogs/*.json (SNT_metadata_master.json, read by snt_metadata_json_trim). Provenance only: never synced to the workspace filesystem and in no pipeline zip, which is why they are kept out of files. The deployer and the checker ignore this block. Optional; may be empty.

webapps.description: {webapp name: webapp spec}, one entry per webapps/<name>/ whose app/ bundle holds at least one file that is not hidden (.gitkeep and other dotfiles are not part of a bundle). The release also attaches each bundle as webapp-<name>-<tag>.zip, with a version.json stamped at release time. Read by no consumer until Phase 7 (the deployer and the checker ignore it). Optional; may be empty.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the file's bytes, as hashlib.hexdigest() writes it.

relative_path.description: A POSIX path relative to the repository root (in zip_files, to the pipeline folder; in a webapp's files, to its app/ folder): no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segment, no empty segment, no backslash.

directory_name.description: One path segment: a folder name.

path.description: The pipeline's folder, 'pipelines/' + its key. Prefix it and '/' to a zip_files entry to get the key into files.

kind.description: The pipeline's kind, from pipelines/registry.json. The deployer deploys a bootstrap pipeline only when the target tag is the latest full release or newer (ADR 0042).

code.description: The OpenHEXA pipeline code: the key with underscores replaced by hyphens (snt_map_extracts -> snt-map-extracts). A pipeline installed from a template may carry it with a '-<6 hex>' suffix (spike S3).

zip_files.description: Paths as they appear inside the pipeline's version zip, i.e. relative to path, so they compare directly against the zip's namelist(). The producer mirrors the openhexa SDK's generate_zip_file(), so the R half under code/, reporting/ and utils/ is listed here too.

path.description: The deployable bundle folder, 'webapps/' + the key + '/app'. Only this folder is deployed (W-rules in webapps/CLAUDE.md).

version.description: The version stamped into the bundle's version.json at release time: the release tag, under one release train (ADR 0037).

files.description: Every file of the bundle as committed, hidden files excepted: {path relative to path: sha256}. The stamped version.json is generated at release time and not listed.
